producer: NOIRLab Astro Data Lab, 'DALServer TAP Query' (Java)

columns.name: coadd_object_id
columns.description: unique identifier for the coadded objects

columns.name: ra
columns.description: right ascension, with quantized precision for indexing (alphawin_j2000 has full precision but not indexed) [degrees]

columns.name: dec
columns.description: declination, with quantized precision for indexing (deltawin_j2000 has full precision but not indexed) [degrees]

columns.name: mag_auto_g
columns.description: g-band magnitude estimation, for an elliptical model based on the kron radius [mag]

columns.name: magerr_auto_g
columns.description: g-band uncertainty in magnitude estimation, for an elliptical model based on the kron radius [mag]

columns.name: flags_g
columns.description: g-band additive flag describing cautionary advice about source extraction process. use less than 4 for well behaved objects

columns.name: extended_class_coadd
columns.description: 0: high confidence stars; 1: candidate stars; 2: mostly galaxies; 3: high confidence galaxies; -9: no data; using sextractor photometry

columns.name: tilename
columns.description: identifier of each one of the tiles on which the survey is gridded

notes: VOTable 1.2 in no namespace at all, with xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation set to 'xmlns:http://...'. BINARY2 is not offered: asking for it returns TABLEDATA.
